description: This file is a Python module for interacting with the JWST Engineering Database (EDB) mnemonics. It provides classes and functions to retrieve, manipulate, and visualize telemetry mnemonic data from the JWST DMS EDB, including querying mnemonic values, validating mnemonics, and generating plots.

classes.name: EdbMnemonic
classes.description: Class to hold and manipulate results of DMS EngDB queries, including data retrieval, plotting, and table generation.

methods.name: get_mnemonic
methods.description: Executes a query to retrieve mnemonic data and returns an EdbMnemonic instance.

methods.name: get_mnemonics
methods.description: Queries multiple mnemonics over a specified time interval and returns a dictionary of EdbMnemonic instances.

methods.name: get_mnemonic_info
methods.description: Returns the description and metadata for a given mnemonic.

methods.name: is_valid_mnemonic
methods.description: Checks if a given mnemonic identifier is valid in the EDB.

methods.name: mnemonic_inventory
methods.description: Returns the complete inventory of mnemonics from the EDB.
